topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Found something odd by the ancient oak, I did. A box, sturdy and sealed, buried not too deep. It held papers and trinkets, some old coins and a spade’s handle, worn but not from this year nor the last. The hands that buried it, they be long gone, I reckon. Summer's end was a good time to find such things, when the soil’s turned and the spirits of the ancestors are close. I set it all down on the clearing, just as I found it, for fear of breaking some old charm. Best to leave the mysteries as they are, else we risk the fickle eye of the saints.
